context.transcript:
Next on the agenda for today's all-staff meeting is one of our new products, the Cut Pro Food Blender.
This is a quick and innovative blender in terms of blade shape and noise reduction.
So our in-house design team deserves a big thank-you for designing this product.
Without a doubt, they exceeded my expectations.
I know that some of you are wondering how this product will do in stores.
Although we haven't sold a lot of units, keep in mind we released the model last week.
So I'll definitely keep you posted.
context.transcript_translation:
今天全员大会的下一个议程是我们的一款新产品——Cut Pro 食品搅拌机。
这款搅拌机在刀片形状和降噪方面都是快速且创新的。
所以我们内部设计团队为设计出这款产品值得一个大大的感谢。
毫无疑问，他们超出了我的期望。
我知道一些人正在想这个产品在商店里会表现如何。
虽然我们没有卖出很多单位，但请记住，我们上周才发布了这款型号。
所以我一定会随时向大家更新进展的。
